simple.meaning: כִּכָּר (kikkâr) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a circle , i.e. (by implication) a circumjacent tract or region, especially the Ghor or valley of the Jordan; also a (round) loaf ; also a talent (or large [round] coin ).” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Genesis 13:10. The surrounding context includes land, mountain, Egypt.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to כִּכָּר (H3603) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
